title: Email Verifier Input
description: Provide a list of email addresses to validate via the Verimailx /bulk-validate API. The API key is configured separately as the APIFY-VERIMAILX-API-KEY environment variable in the Apify console. If the API key is not set, the Actor falls back to local syntax-only validation so it can still produce a usable result.

emails.title: Emails to verify
emails.description: Array of email address strings. Duplicates are removed; batches larger than 1,000 are split into multiple API calls. If the Verimailx API key is not configured, the Actor falls back to local syntax-only validation.
